summary: The most-installed skills are about planning and working with an agent (Matt Pocock's grill-me, handoff, teach; find-skills), video (HeyGen HyperFrames) and design. Many top slots are bundles from one publisher (about 20 Lark/Feishu skills at about 750k installs each), so raw counts overstate real use. Left out: 19 Lark/Feishu office skills (about 750k installs each, looks inflated, not useful here).

tools.quote: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X"
tools.check: Install count (3.7M) is the highest by far; Vercel Labs is a known publisher but still read any skill it finds before installing.
